## UMAP Visualization — Final Cell Type Annotation (r3)

```{r umap-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(dittoSeq)
library(ggplot2)

analysis_path <- "/restricted/projectnb/camplab/projects/20220504_Suzuki_LN/TumorIMC/analysis/final_cell_annotation"
spe_path <- file.path(analysis_path, "r3_annotation", "spe_final_celltype_r3.rds")
spe <- readRDS(spe_path)

if (is(colData(spe)$patient_id, "Rle")) {
  colData(spe)$patient_id <- as.character(as.vector(colData(spe)$patient_id))
}
```

```{r umap-celltype, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
p_umap_celltype <- dittoDimPlot(
  spe,
  var = "final_celltype",
  reduction.use = "UMAP_harmony",
  size = 0.5,
  do.label = TRUE,
  labels.size = 3,
  legend.size = 3
) + 
  ggtitle("UMAP (Harmony): Final Cell Type Annotation") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3), ncol = 1)) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

print(p_umap_celltype)
```

```{r umap-patient, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
p_umap_patient <- dittoDimPlot(
  spe,
  var = "patient_id",
  reduction.use = "UMAP_harmony",
  size = 0.5
) + ggtitle("UMAP (Harmony): Patient ID")

print(p_umap_patient)
```

```{r umap-disease-state, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
p_umap_disease <- dittoDimPlot(
  spe,
  var = "disease_state",
  reduction.use = "UMAP_harmony",
  size = 0.5
) + ggtitle("UMAP (Harmony): Disease State")

print(p_umap_disease)
```

```{r umap-broad-celltype, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# useful for comparing broad vs final annotation side by side
p_umap_broad <- dittoDimPlot(
  spe,
  var = "broad_celltype",
  reduction.use = "UMAP_harmony",
  size = 0.5,
  do.label = TRUE,
  labels.size = 3
) + ggtitle("UMAP (Harmony): Broad Cell Type Annotation")

print(p_umap_broad)
```
